newsitem.title: FRANCE: NRJ radio market share dips in Q2, RTL's rises.
newsitem.headline: NRJ radio market share dips in Q2, RTL's rises.

text.p: The market share for French music radio station NRJ dipped in the April to June quarter from the 1997 first quarter, while that of RTL rose, according to figures from French audience measurement body Mediametrie published on Tuesday.
But RTL, France's largest general radio station, saw its number of listeners tuning in at least once a day slip during in the April to June period, despite the rise in market share.

Europe 1, France's other main privately-owned general radio station, also saw its market share slip in the April to June period, while the number of people tuning in to the station at least once a day remained stable, Mediametrie said.
